title: C# API differences to GDScript
key_points: This source lists the main differences between using C# and GDScript in Godot.
It covers general differences, global scope, constants, math functions, random functions, other functions, tips, and a full list of equivalences.
The document encourages the use of C# idioms and style guide for writing C# code in Godot.
limitations: The document is incomplete and states so itself.
It assumes some familiarity with both GDScript and C++ as well as the Godot engine.
The scope of equivalences provided may not cover all possible differences.
asserts: C# API in Godot strives to be idiomatic to C# instead of directly mirroring GDScript or C++ APIs, using PascalCase for method names and properties for getters/setters where available.
scope: The context is the usage and best practices for writing C# code that interfaces with the Godot game engine, specifically when translating GDScript or C++ code to C#.
